remediatedFindings.resolution: Academy authoring now derives privilege only from profiles.app_role and repeats the production MFA check server-side.
Both admin page families now share the canonical role, MFA, and idle-session boundary.
Strict bounded schemas and runtime block validation now run before every Academy service-role content write.
The project status-report route and all Academy content mutations now emit actor-bound audit events.
The authoring UI explicitly labels expected output as practice-only and reserves trusted mastery for private server checks.
Missing provider configuration and failed sends are represented as failures or dead letters, never as an unpersisted queue.
All direct Resend email paths now use the canonical sender or explicit provider idempotency keys.
Signed webhook events are claimed through an atomic database lease and completed duplicates are acknowledged exactly once.
Delivery attempts use bounded exponential backoff and transition to a durable dead letter after three attempts or a permanent failure.
Public readiness now uses an anonymous bounded probe, removes service-role access, and returns only safe error codes.
Telemetry and Sentry events now minimize URLs, redact common secrets/PII, bound metrics and sampling, and suppress privileged request fields.
Query failures return unavailable/503 and no-sample states remain unknown; the diagnostic ratio is no longer presented as a true error-rate SLO.
The release gate now reconciles all local checkpoints, re-hashes required evidence, validates Git ancestry, rejects secret values, and preserves every external approval boundary.
